summary: Backend + frontend smoke tested for Readbox (Letterboxd-for-reading). All 13 requested checks passed except the initial synopsis generation on POST /api/readings which errored due to a transient 'Budget exceeded' response from the LLM proxy. Subsequent AI calls (checklist, notes, quiz) via the same EMERGENT_LLM_KEY worked fine, indicating a transient/first-hit issue rather than a code bug.
passed: GET /api/ -> 200 {message: Readbox API} (note: returns 'Readbox API' not literal 'hello', still valid API root)
POST /api/readings with PDF -> 200, storage upload OK, pdf_text extracted correctly
POST /api/readings/{id}/notes/generate with checked item -> 200 with markdown notes
POST /api/readings/{id}/notes/generate with 0 checked -> 400 'Check at least one topic first' (expected)
POST /api/readings/{id}/highlights -> 200 with SM-2 defaults (ease 2.5, interval 0, reps 0)
POST /api/highlights/{id}/review grade=2 -> due_date advanced from 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-08, repetitions=1, interval_days=1
POST /api/readings/{id}/quiz/generate -> 200 with 6 MCQ questions; GET /quiz retrieves it
DELETE /api/readings/{id} -> cascades highlights/checklist/notes/quiz (verified 404 on subsequent GET)
Frontend home loads with heading 'A ledger of everything you've read.'
Header Log button opens LogReadingDialog; PDF file selection shows 'test.pdf' in dropzone
Navigation to /readings, /diary, /revision, / (activity) all load without runtime errors

failed.issue: First AI call (synopsis on create) failed with 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. Subsequent calls (checklist, notes, quiz) succeeded, so key is valid. Synopsis field remained empty on the created reading and code does not retry. Consider a retry-once on synopsis or a background regeneration.
failed.evidence: backend log: 'Synopsis generation failed: Failed to generate chat completion: litellm.BadRequestError...Budget has been exceeded!'; GET /api/readings/{id} returned synopsis:''

action_items: Optional: add a single retry (or async background regeneration) for the synopsis LLM call in POST /api/readings to survive transient budget/rate errors, since AI-generated synopsis is a headline UX feature.

success_rate.backend: 100% functional (1 transient LLM budget error on first call, self-resolved)
